title: 内连接
objective: 按外键连接已支付订单与顾客，明确同名列来自哪张表。
statement: 查询全部已支付（status = 'paid'）订单及其顾客，依次输出 order_id（orders.id）、customer_id（customers.id）、customer_name（customers.name）。按 orders.customer_id = customers.id 连接，每张订单一行。同名顾客和同一顾客的多张订单分别保留，不要求行顺序。
knowledge: INNER JOIN 只保留满足 ON 关联条件的组合行。写法为 FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.id。
AS o / AS c 是表别名，只在当前查询中使用；o.id 与 c.id 指向不同表的同名列，必须明确来源。输出别名则仍写在 SELECT 中。
不要用 o.id = c.id 连接两个不同业务的编号，也不能省略关联条件形成所有行的组合。
先按编号连接，再用 WHERE 筛状态；一位顾客匹配多张订单时会出现多行，这是正确的一对多结果，不需要去重。
starterSql: -- 按外键连接已支付订单与顾客，明确同名列来自哪张表。

flowchart.exampleSql: SELECT o.id AS order_id, c.name AS customer_name FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'pending';

nodes.label: 连接按关系，不按列同名
nodes.description: 示例为待支付订单补上顾客姓名；题目要求已支付订单，且多输出顾客编号。

nodes.label:
两张表各有简称
o、c
nodes.description: o 是 orders 的表别名，c 是 customers 的表别名。o.id 代表订单编号，c.id 代表顾客编号，不是同一个字段。

nodes.label:
真正的对应关系
o.customer_id = c.id
nodes.description: 用订单外键找顾客主键。不能改成 o.id = c.id，也不能省掉 ON 后形成所有行的任意组合。

nodes.label: INNER JOIN 只保留匹配
nodes.description: 满足关联条件的组合才输出；没有订单匹配的顾客不会凭空出现。同一顾客的多张匹配订单会分别输出。

nodes.label: 筛状态，再说明输出
nodes.description: WHERE 选 pending 订单；SELECT 中 o.id AS order_id 设置结果列名，与 FROM 中的表别名职责不同。

hints.text: 用订单的 customer_id 找到顾客，每张订单仍输出一行。
用 o.customer_id = c.id 作 ON 条件，给输出列分别命名。
SELECT o.id AS order_id, c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN customers AS c ON ____ WHERE o.status = 'paid';

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT o.id AS order_id, c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'paid';
referenceSolutions.explanation: 关联键找对顾客，订单编号仍取自 orders；两个名为林杉的顾客由编号区分。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT o.id AS order_id, c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN customers AS c ON o.id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'paid';
SELECT o.id AS order_id, c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN customers AS c ON 1 = 1 WHERE o.status = 'paid';
